name: Sweet Chilli Beef Skewers with Veg Rice
method: Soak 8 wooden skewers in water for 10 minutes. Cook the rice to the packet instructions, about 12 minutes, then drain.
Heat the grill to medium-high. Toss the beef strips and halved tomatoes with two thirds of the sweet chilli sauce, then thread onto the skewers.
Grill the skewers for 6 minutes, turning once, until the beef is cooked through.
Meanwhile heat the oil in a wok and stir-fry the baby corn, sugar snap peas and spring onions for 2 minutes, adding a splash of water to steam.
Add the rice and the rest of the sweet chilli sauce and cook for 2 minutes until hot. Serve the skewers on the rice with lime wedges and torn coriander.
